task_summary: Customer reports that the Porcelain Dinner Set from ORD-6023 arrived damaged during transit. Correct handling is the shipping-damage path: review the shipping and return policy, issue a refund for the item, provide a return label, and include a fragile item goodwill credit if applicable.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must issue the separate $10 fragile-item goodwill credit to original payment.
